profile.headline: Software Engineer II, Team Lead
profile.summary: I love thinking about the ways software and automation can improve workflows and simplify complex processes.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
During my 2021 internship at SPITwSPOTS,

I developed and deployed a Python Flask based ETL connector to replicate Quickbooks Online report data to Google BigQuery, using Quickbooks REST API, Google BigQuery and authentication APIs, Google App Engine, and Google Cloud Tasks.

I wrote Google BigQuery-flavored SQL to create and retrieve data from predictive machine learning models and designed Google DataStudio dashboards to display the interactive data for company financial and workplace incident data.
positions.insights: Skills: Flask · Git · JavaScript · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Bootstrap · Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · PyUnit · Google Data Studio · Google BigQuery · Google App Engine

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
During my 2020 internship at SPITwSPOTS,

I developed and deployed an automated configuration software solution in Node.js for Ubiquiti AirOS, EdgeOS, and AirCube devices, that leverages the Red Hat Ansible automation tool for configuring devices using SSH and Google Puppeteer for configuring web GUI devices.

I wrote Google BigQuery-flavored SQL to create and retrieve data from predictive machine learning models and designed Google DataStudio dashboards to display the interactive data for company install job and hardware usage statistics.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Node.js · Ansible · Google Data Studio · Google BigQuery

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
During my internship at SVT,

I redesigned SVT's WordPress-based intranet for improved file-management and staff communication

I researched and implemented a new staff scheduling system for SVT Health & Wellness medical staff

I provided technical support across multiple locations as the only on-site domain admin for a 2 week period
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:

I ran cable for and installed new wireless access points

projects.title: Capstone Project | Lunch Ordering System
projects.description:
My Computer Science capstone project, completed with a group of 4 CS majors (including myself) is a web application built to replace the paper and spreadsheet based lunch management system of a small local school with a cloud-based solution that facilitates ordering and payment online for parents, and report generation and management tasks for lunch program administrators.

Technical details:
Frontend: React web app served through Google App Engine, user authentication using Firebase Authentication
Backend: REST API (Python Flask) served through Google App Engine, token-based authentication using Firebase Authentication, Firebase Firestore Database
Payment processing using Stripe Checkout
